highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 upgrades to Skia m151 and delivers significant managed-layer performance improvements.
highlights_body: This release upgrades the Skia engine to chrome/m151, fixes a native resource leak in SKImage, and includes a focused performance pass: managed color conversions, allocation-free HarfBuzz UTF-8 encoding, zero-copy shaper spans, and reduced string allocations across the API.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine is now built from chrome/m151, with multiple rounds of upstream stability and bug fix merges included.
New WASM static libraries built with Emscripten 5.0.6 (with the new exnref exception-handling model) are included for upcoming .NET 11 WASM support.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing optimized with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads
bullets.detail: SKColor.Parse and TryParse now have ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads and an optimized hex parser, reducing allocations in color-from-string scenarios.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) fixed
bullets.detail: A native handle was not being released when the cropped region was identical to the full image, causing a resource leak. The handle is now correctly freed.

bullets.lead: Managed color conversion ported away from P/Invoke
bullets.detail: SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion and SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply operations are now implemented in managed integer math, eliminating per-call native round-trips.
AddUtf8(string) now pools its UTF-8 encoding buffer rather than allocating on every call, removing a hot-path allocation in text shaping.

bullets.lead: SKShaper glyph results read via zero-copy spans
bullets.detail: Glyph and cluster arrays from HarfBuzz are now read through Span instead of copies, reducing allocations in every shaping call.
The per-call char[4] allocation in HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse has been removed using stackalloc.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Managed color conversion, allocation-free HarfBuzz UTF-8 encoding, zero-copy shaper spans, and Tag.Parse de-allocation

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: RC 1 delivered the Skia m151 upgrade (including WASM Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries), the WASM exception-handling preview test job, and the final round of stability fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 landed the performance improvements: managed color conversion, allocation-free HarfBuzz UTF-8, zero-copy shaper spans, Tag.Parse de-allocation, and the SKColor hex-parsing optimization.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151 line with the initial Skia m151 milestone upgrade and the native resource leak fix in SKImage.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release, with performance improvements to AddUtf8 (allocation-free pooled UTF-8 encoding) and Tag.Parse (stack-allocated, no heap allocation).
